rule: Remove the logo and every proper noun from a screenshot: a person must name the product within two seconds. A screen that could belong to another product fails review, whatever else it does right.

nicks-public.metaphor: the physical shop on Euclid Ave: garage signage, service manual, street photography, newspaper ad, shop wall
nicks-public.dominantObject: a service / an action (call, directions, pull up, drop off)
nicks-public.composition: irregular, editorial, full-bleed; sections do not live in boxes; prices, hours and the address are typography
nicks-public.geometry: editorial; imagery bleeds off the viewport; few enclosed rectangles
nicks-public.typographyRole: huge advertising display (Barlow Condensed) for the one promise per section; body copy in the shop's own voice

paletteSemantics.gold: the sign, a price, the one action
paletteSemantics.signal: red only for the emergency call CTA

nicks-public.motion: physical, cinematic reveals (~850ms); nothing instant or twitchy
nicks-public.navigation: the customer journey (where, open?, tires vs repair, call, directions)
nicks-public.imageVideoRole: primary material: real tires, bays, concrete, salt, signage, Cleveland
bannedPatterns: fabricated real-time dispatch or wait-time widgets

nicks-admin.metaphor: dispatch board × trader terminal × repair-shop whiteboard; an instrument, not a website
nicks-admin.dominantObject: a work item (car / call / estimate / payment) and the stage it is stuck at
nicks-admin.composition: rectangular, dense, tabular: rows, queues, lanes, status rails; the UI almost disappears
nicks-admin.geometry: rectangular; hairline rules; containers only as containers
nicks-admin.typographyRole: compact utilitarian sans; mono tabular numerics for money and time

paletteSemantics.background: graphite / neutral (the `neutral` admin theme is the default look)
paletteSemantics.gold: owner / business priority — at most one thing on a screen
paletteSemantics.signal: --data-up / --data-down / --data-warn / --data-crit / --data-info for state; --data-purple allowed as a semantic class

nicks-admin.navigation: the workflow: demand → contact → commitment → arrival → inspection → authorization → parts → work → complete → payment → retention
nicks-admin.imageVideoRole: none, except a vehicle thumbnail on a work item
hierarchy: what is happening in the shop
where flow is accumulating or breaking

statenour.metaphor: mission control for one life: command deck, timeline, dossier, cockpit HUD, living memory; a private editorial workbench
statenour.dominantObject: a mission / decision / commitment with its evidence around it
statenour.composition: cinematic and hierarchical: one dominant thought (`.vt-verdict`), a gold rule, then a rail; ruled lists, eyebrow h2s
statenour.geometry: void and depth; rules instead of boxes; a card must earn its border
statenour.typographyRole: dramatic command display (Barlow Condensed verdicts), mono 11–12px metadata, 15–18px body

paletteSemantics.gold: identity: the active nav item, the mission rule, the verdict's emphasis

statenour.motion: deliberate: ViewTransition on inspect, nothing decorative
statenour.navigation: the mission (spine: home · chat · missions · journal · brain · people · system · stats)
statenour.imageVideoRole: rare; the graph canvas is the one full-bleed surface
bannedPatterns: routine shop state in personal navigation

lot.metaphor: surveillance / spatial instrument: live video with reality overlaid
lot.dominantObject: a vehicle (track / visit) in a zone at a time
lot.composition: viewport + overlays; the event ledger under the frame; timeline for replay
lot.geometry: the video frame; technical overlays; almost no enclosed panels

paletteSemantics.signal: amber / red / green for operational state only

lot.imageVideoRole: primary material: live / recent scene, replay
bannedPatterns: plate or customer identity outside the narrow permission

diagnostics.note: Interpretable, per-screen; none of these is a pass/fail on its own. HARD FAIL only on an explicit bannedPattern; WARN on an unusual convergence; REVIEW on several convergence signals on a major new or changed screen.
diagnostics.crossProduct: registered ink-mass distance (apps/statenour/tests/e2e/visual-distance.ts) between a candidate screen and the other products' committed renders — must be far apart (floor to calibrate once nickstire renders exist)
